specs.title: matching uses whole Chinese words, English word starts and UTF-16 offsets
matching ranks titles then headings ahead of repeated body matches
matching requires all words in one section and groups pages with stable pagination
matching retains request identities and serves warm queries without network
matching scans the real 100-page guide corpus with one registered page
recovery refuses nonlocal indexes, failed HTTP and invalid schemas
recovery reports unsupported word boundaries and invalid queries explicitly
recovery loads a fresh module URL after first HTTP failure and retains the input
recovery loads a fresh module URL after first network failure and retains the input
recovery loads a fresh module URL after first module-shape failure and retains the input
recovery keeps the latest input through delayed JSON and ignores closed sessions
recovery retries JSON failures with a new Worker and the successful module
recovery leaves a timed-out import inert after retry succeeds
recovery abandons an import closed before load and opens a fresh session
recovery handles Worker error and keeps input for a successful retry
recovery handles Worker messageerror and keeps input for a successful retry
recovery handles Worker timeout and keeps input for a successful retry
recovery handles Worker query-timeout and keeps input for a successful retry
recovery ignores old query and instance messages and defers composing input
search is lazy, focuses synchronously and distinguishes idle, results and no matches
keyboard selection, more results and ordinary links retain the full page count
